stackDivergence.rationale: Task132 supplies the actual offapi Color typedef and XTheme/XComplexColor contracts needed by native complex-color Any transport. IDL util::Color remains a compile-only number alias for signed32 UNO long and introduces no runtime TYPEDEF or pixel buffer. XTheme extends actual XInterface and returns actual OUString/Sequence<Color>; XComplexColor exposes original signed32 getType/getThemeColorType and resolveColor(Reference<XTheme>) using existing shared generic declarations. Native normal getters reuse original CPPU static_mi_interface_type_init with0explicitbases and actual borrowed type-cell view, including implicit XInterface, native incomplete reflection state and cold/warm identity. Original deprecated Reference pointer getters and static_type wrappers use existing UnoType with explicit erased template type, never a value-inferred provider. Upstream cppumaker defaultdynamic/normal mode and gbuild ordinary offapi target are the source; comprehensive-C and lightweight-L are different genuine modes and no comprehensive method table is fabricated. Existing normal FontHeight/FontSlant bindings use the same approach. Pure IDL alias provenance cites the complete published typedef long Color declaration rather than basename-only similarity. Real Any/Reference typed-null same/root/cross interface admission and signed32 Color scalar transport are exercised, with no fake component or default theme. Type-only alias has no executable coverage counters; both new executable modules are measured completely. Native component UnoComplexColor, WeakImplHelper inheritance/lifetime integration and full SvxColorItem Any/Writer color migration remain pending; tests do not certify non-null components, dynamic fullReflection, true DocPool/document/UI/same-model ODS or native ABI. No C++generator/build/probe, no new allocator/refcount/type factory or provider; existing IO/recovery deviations and readiness-gated full regression remain unchanged.
